lines.t: Begin again in me and be renewed
That you may continue to bear much fruit
In my name until the time the day I finish you
But love it, listen closely
And take my words to heart
Oh, you who call of yourselves Christian
I ask you, do you really love me?
Then follow me
Beloved ones, listen closely
And take my words to heart
All you who call yourselves Christian
Do you really love me?
Then obey my words
Follow me
Then obey my word, follow me
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Lovely ones, listen closely
And take my words to heart
All you call of yourselves Christian
Do you really love me?
Then heed my voice and come out
Follow me
